text:
Unfortunately, one older leaf yellowing a week after delivery isn't covered on its own. Yellowing of one or two older leaves in the first two weeks is considered normal transplant stress.

If the plant declines significantly, meaning it loses more than a third of its leaves, develops stem or root rot, or collapses, you can file a claim from "My Orders". Your guarantee is 30 days from delivery, or 90 days if you're a Leafy Plus member and ordered while the membership was active. Include at least two photos (whole plant and a close-up), and a Plant Care Specialist will review within 2 business days.

In the meantime, water only when the top inch of soil is dry, since overwatering is the most common cause of early problems. Also avoid repotting for 2-3 weeks. You can also chat or email a Plant Care Specialist for free advice.
